skill: Locate a highlighted matrix entry, count its one-based row and column, and express the ordered indices in matrix-entry notation.
reasoning_steps: Count row from top and column from left; do not interchange them.
Select or enter the lower-case matrix symbol with ordered subscripts, or enter i and j separately.
invariants: Exactly one identifiable highlighted cell; valid one-based coordinates.
Letter agrees with matrix label; first subscript is row, second is column.
Easy visual indexing of small integer matrices, without arithmetic or new operators.
Retain radio, symbolic blank, and two-index blank response families and complete source banks for replay.
permitted_variations: Highlight may move to every valid cell, including diagonal, off-diagonal and edges; source positions are incidental.
Small square and rectangular dimensions, matrix labels, integer entries, distractor indices and option positions may vary.
Changing values alone is irrelevant to the answer; relocating the highlight changes the answer; consistent renaming changes the symbol only.
